news_1_10_0: Links to the home page, «Discover» and profiles now show a preview image when shared. And fixed: two people asking each other to be friends at the same moment are now friends, and a collection can be added to again after one of its routes was deleted.
news_1_9_0: New on routes, multi-day hikes and in the planner: «Snow on the way» says how much of the way lies in snow and how much of it is steeper than 30°. And «Show on the map» takes the map to the spot, also for protected areas, closures and shooting.
news_1_8_0: Planning now works even when swisstopo's elevation service is down: Alvyo has Switzerland's heights itself. And when the base map does not load, the map shows the national map.
news_1_7_1: The snow box on the map is smaller: the day and the colours, more with ⓘ. In the app the list of data sources closes again.
news_1_7_0: New on the map: «Snow (satellite)» shows where there is snow in the Alps, daily from Copernicus satellite images. Handy for hikes in autumn and spring.
news_1_6_0: You can sign in with Apple, on the website and in the iPhone app, also with your e-mail address hidden. Shared links to routes, journeys, collections and invites open straight in the app on the iPhone and iPad.
news_1_5_0: On the website you plan as in the app: a click on the map sets a destination, and with the dot halfway along a section you drag the line onto another path or put a stop there. In the app, «+ Stop» now shows a single search field. «Name the mountains» also works with the iPad held sideways.
news_1_4_0: When planning in the app, drag points on the map to another place, and with the dot halfway along a section drag the line onto another path or put a stop there. In «Several days» you add stops and change their order. On Android, «Plan» shows the map again.
news_1_3_0: You can now create an account right in the app, without going to the website. «Forgot your password?» and the privacy policy open inside the app.
news_1_2_0: Alvyo on the iPad: the sections are in a bar on the left, and routes, multi-day hikes, planning and discovering show the map at full height beside the details, upright and on its side. An iPhone turned sideways shows them the same way.
news_1_1_0: Passkeys are gone: you log in with your password or a connected account; if you only had a passkey, set a password with “Forgot your password?”. A route's map now shows everything listed under “Along the way”, even kinds switched off in the map layers. The screenshot sent with “Report a bug” goes with the report into the private GitHub repository.
news_1_0_0: Version 1.0, ready for the App Store: the iPhone app shows the Alvyo logo when it starts, and when it asks for your location, the camera, your photos or Apple Health, it now says why in your language.
news_0_34_0: The app is now on Android too (to download with every version on GitHub). Hikes from the Apple Watch import again, and «Again» brings one in once more as a new route. «About» lists all data sources and says more about privacy. The Komoot import is gone: export your tours from Komoot as GPX and import the file here.
news_0_33_0: New in «Reach»: tap inside an area and plan a route there right away – from the start, with the same profile, in the app as a round trip back to the start if you like. Fixed: the app's planner broke on a round trip.
news_0_32_0: New under «Account»: access tokens for AI assistants such as Claude and the command-line tool alvyo-cli. With one they plan routes, search places, check weather and closures and see your routes and journeys – they cannot change anything.
news_0_31_0: New in «Discover»: the official hiking routes of Hiking in Switzerland – national, regional, local and barrier-free routes, linked to SwitzerlandMobility, with a «Source» filter. Any route or journey you can see you can «edit as your own». In the app a collection shows its tours on one map.
news_0_30_0: A new account logs in once you have confirmed your e-mail address, and under «Account» you can log out on all other devices. While planning, Alvyo asks before unsaved points are lost, and the points of a journey can be moved. Also many fixes, more readable colours in dark mode and more help for screen readers.
news_0_29_1: «Reach» shows the way out first, and its areas no longer have holes; its map has the map layer menu.
news_0_29_0: The app is arranged anew: Discover, Plan, Tours and Profile. New there: round trips and stopovers, importing files, taking over Apple Watch hikes automatically and following a tour while recording.
news_0_28_0: «Name the mountains» draws the nearer ridges too, and on a summit nothing hides the view any more.
news_0_27_0: New in the app: «Name the mountains» names the summits you see through the camera, also without reception.
about_intro: Alvyo is an open platform for planning and sharing hikes in Switzerland.
about_source: Alvyo is free software under the AGPL-3.0. The source code of this version is available here:
about_notice: Licences and sources of other people's code and data:
about_data_intro: Alvyo shows data from these sources; thanks to everyone who makes them openly available:
about_src_swisstopo: Federal Office of Topography swisstopo: national maps, aerial images, base map, swissALTI3D elevation model, relief, slopes and hiking trails (swissTLM3D)
about_src_astra: Federal Roads Office FEDRO (ASTRA) and SchweizMobil: the official routes of Wanderland Schweiz, closures and diversions of hiking trails
about_src_bafu: Federal Office for the Environment FOEN (BAFU) and the cantons: wildlife rest areas and federal hunting reserves
about_src_vbs: Federal Department of Defence, Civil Protection and Sport DDPS (VBS): shooting notices
about_src_meteo: Source: MeteoSwiss – weather forecasts, rain radar, precipitation forecast (ICON-CH1) and climate normals
about_src_copernicus: Generated using European Union's Copernicus Land Monitoring Service information: snow cover (HR-WSI, daily, 60 m), coloured and cut to Switzerland by us
about_src_transport: opentransportdata.swiss: timetable and connections (Open Journey Planner)
about_src_bav: Federal Office of Transport FOT (BAV): public transport stops
about_src_osm: © OpenStreetMap contributors: the path network for routing, huts, accommodation, places and summits
about_src_mapterhorn: Mapterhorn (from Copernicus GLO-30, swissALTI3D and the neighbouring countries' elevation models): terrain for the 3D map and «Name the mountains» in the app
about_src_terrain: Terrain Tiles by Mapzen (EU-DEM: produced using Copernicus data and information funded by the European Union; SRTM: courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey): slopes for «How far can I get?»
about_src_hikingtime: Hiking times after the formula of SchweizMobil / Swiss Hiking Trail Federation
about_safety: Hiking times and difficulties are computed estimates. Check weather, conditions and the signposts on site.
about_privacy: We store what your account needs: e-mail address, username, display name, a password hash (argon2id) and your routes, journeys, collections, comments, bookmarks, follows and blocks. Only what you publish, your comments on it, your display name and how many followers you have are public. If you invite someone by e-mail, we store that address for the invitation. Reports, including the reported text, are kept for moderation. For linked accounts we store the provider's ID and e-mail address, and for Apple also a token with which we revoke the sign-in when you delete your account or disconnect Apple. A cookie keeps you logged in; there are no ads. For statistics we use Google Analytics (Google Ireland; data may reach the USA): which pages are viewed, without the parts of addresses that grant access (share and invitation links, live locations) and without the titles of your tours. Google sets cookies only with your consent (changeable under «Statistics»); otherwise Google receives page views only, without cookies or an identifier. Of photos we keep only the pictures themselves: we remove metadata such as the camera and where the photo was taken; if that place lies along the route, we keep it as a point on the map. Server logs with IP addresses are kept only briefly, for troubleshooting and to fend off abuse.
about_privacy_services: Alvyo runs on our own servers in Switzerland; e-mails are sent through Infomaniak (Switzerland). Tiles of the national map and the terrain load through our server; your browser loads the base map (vector) and fonts directly from swisstopo (geo.admin.ch). For elevation profiles, the place search and notices along the route our server sends coordinates to swisstopo (geo.admin.ch), for connections stops and times to opentransportdata.swiss, in each case without anything about you. If you log in with Google or Apple, the provider learns that you log in to Alvyo. If you report a bug, it goes as an issue to a private GitHub repository only we can see, with your text, the page, the version, your username and the screenshot.
about_privacy_app: In the app your location stays on the device, unless you save a recorded hike or share your live location: we keep live locations until 7 days after the end. With your permission the app reads hikes and their tracks from Apple Health (Apple Watch) and turns them into routes; it reads no other health data, and we pass none on. The camera and motion sensors for «Name the mountains» are used on the device only. The app measures statistics with Google Analytics (Firebase) only with your consent (asked at the first start, changeable under Profile › Settings › Statistics): which kinds of screens are opened, such as «Route», without titles, places and links and without an advertising ID. Google receives a random ID of the installation, details of the device (model, operating system, language) and the region Google derives from the IP address. Without your consent Google receives nothing; if you decline later, the app deletes its ID.
about_privacy_rights: You can ask what data we hold about you and have it corrected or deleted: write to the address below. You can delete your account with all its content yourself at any time under «Account».
about_operator: Responsible for Alvyo and for processing your data:
account_delete_text: Permanently deletes your account and all your routes. Shared links stop working.

seo_home_title: Plan and share hikes in Switzerland
seo_home_description: Plan hikes on the swisstopo national maps, with official hiking times and the SAC scale. Multi-day journeys, offline maps in the app and public routes to discover.
seo_discover_description: Find public hikes and multi-day journeys in Switzerland on the map, filtered by difficulty and hiking time.
seo_profile_description: Public hikes and multi-day journeys by {name}.
home_feature_plan: Plan routes on the swisstopo national maps, with hiking times from the official formula and the SAC scale.
home_feature_journeys: Multi-day journeys with accommodation and the way there by public transport.
home_feature_app: Navigate with the iPhone app, even without a network, and record your hikes.
home_feature_discover: Discover other people's public routes, build collections and bring in routes from GPX files.
home_headline: Walk until the map runs out.
travel_no_date: The stage has no date: today’s connections.
travel_no_homes: Add a home you often need in your account.

travel_no_route: Once a stage has a route.

reach_busy: Working out how far you get …

reach_hint_login: Log in to see how far you get.

reach_error_other: Could not be worked out. Please try again.
reach_plan_hint: Click inside an area to plan a route there.
tokens_title: Access tokens for AI assistants and scripts
tokens_intro: With an access token, AI assistants such as Claude and the command-line program alvyo‑cli read your account: they plan routes, look up places, weather and closures, and see your routes and journeys. They cannot change anything. Give a token only to programs you trust.
tokens_created: Copy the token now: it is shown only this once.
tokens_revoke_confirm: Revoke “{name}”? Programs with this token can then no longer get into your account.
tokens_full: You already have 20 tokens. Revoke one first.
